levitate.effect: This Pokémon is immune to Ground-type moves, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Arena Trap. This ability is disabled during Gravity or Ingrain, or while holding an Iron Ball. This ability is not disabled during Roost.
levitate.flavor: By floating in the air, the Pokémon receives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.

tackle.name: Tackle
tackle.shortEffect: Inflicts regular damage with no additional effect.

spark.name: Spark
spark.shortEffect: Has a chance to paralyze the target.
spark.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to paralyze the target.

charge-beam.name: Charge Beam
charge-beam.shortEffect: Has a chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.
charge-beam.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Has a chance to raise the user’s Special Attack by one stage.

charge.name: Charge
charge.shortEffect: Raises the user’s Special Defense by one stage. User’s Electric moves have doubled power next turn.
charge.effect: Raises the user’s Special Defense by one stage. If the user uses an Electric move next turn, its power will be doubled.

knock-off.name: Knock Off
knock-off.effect: Inflicts regular damage. Target loses its held item. Neither the user nor the target can recover its item with Recycle. If the target has Multitype or Sticky Hold, it will take damage but not lose its item.
